verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a CLI installable via npm with a headless mode for scripts and CI/CD. The docs cover processable output, auto-approve flags (`cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"`), stdin piping, cron scheduling that persists across restarts, and headless runs inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.
